stimulus.body: L'extrait ci-dessous sert à vérifier la compréhension de cette forme. Parmi les quatre réponses, une seule s'appuie sur le texte lui-même.

questions.stem: Parmi les affirmations sur cette forme que propose l'extrait précédent, laquelle est la seule que le texte permette de retenir ?

options.text: No disclosure if followers trust them.
A hidden note in the comments.
Clear, visible disclosure of the partnership.

options.misconception: substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for the relation the passage establishes

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: the core duty is clear, visible disclosure. On that basis "Clear, visible disclosure of the partnership" is the supported choice. Option A ("No disclosure if followers trust them") fails because it trust does not remove duty; Option B ("A hidden note in the comments") fails because it not visible enough; Option D ("Disclosure only to the brand") fails because it substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for the disclosure an influencer owes.
